ensemble.rule: best two of the pool by selection WAPE; w grid-fit on selection origins only (ENSEMBLE_GRID, ties -> smallest w)

band.method: split-conformal: lo/hi = point ± per-horizon-day quantile of |lgbm residual| over the SELECTION origins (8 x n_series calibration points per h), level 0.8; zero-clipped and sorted. p50 = point forecast; p90 = hi band edge.

catalog_rule: deterministic: within each (store, class) cell, series are ordered by total panel volume descending (ties -> unique_id) and the evenly spaced ranks [0, 1, len//2, len-1] (first CATALOG_PER_CELL of them) are picked, so every cell spans high/mid/low volume
curve_provenance: per-series curves (seasonal_naive, auto_ets) re-run the m5_track functions on the catalog subset and reproduce the committed full-panel forecasts exactly (per-series fits); convex_ensemble applies the committed selection rule (auto_ets x weight_on_a + auto_ces x (1-w)) to the member curves; lgbm is a catalog-subset refit of the fixed config (the committed global model trains on all 600 series) — per-series test WAPEs in each window are computed from these curves

dataset.subset_rule: top-3 stores by total units (CA_3, CA_1, TX_2) x top-200 items by total units within those stores; deterministic ranking, see data_m5/PROVENANCE.md
dataset.citation: Makridakis et al., M5 competition companion, International Journal of Forecasting (2022); research use with attribution per competition terms

split.holdout_designation: last 2 origins = test, scored once; selection (ensemble weight, conformal calibration, class anchoring) uses the earlier origins only

evaluation_metadata.determinism: VECLIB_MAXIMUM_THREADS=1 pinned in cli.py before numpy; LightGBM n_jobs=1 + fixed seed + force_row_wise; statsforecast n_jobs=1; statsforecast models are closed-form/seed-free
